## Contribution contract
- [ ] This is a bounded capability with a complete manifest.
- [ ] Inputs, outputs, invariants, state ownership and failure behaviour are documented.
- [ ] Dependencies and replaceability are declared.
- [ ] Tests include normal, boundary, negative and failure cases.
- [ ] Independent expected results are included.
- [ ] Mutation test demonstrates that tests detect a deliberately incorrect implementation.
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are included.
- [ ] I have not claimed qualification beyond the evidence.
